_comment: Deny rules for guard-command. type=regex matches the whole command with Python re.search; other types are structural checks implemented in coding_plugin.py and applied to each command segment. Disable a rule with "disabledGuards": ["<id>"] in .coding-plugin.json; add your own with commandRules.extraDeny.

rules.message: Recursive delete of the filesystem root, your home directory, the repository root or a bare wildcard is blocked.
Force-pushing to (or deleting) a protected branch rewrites shared history. Push to a feature branch and open a pull request instead.
git reset --hard on a protected branch discards work. Create a branch first, or use git stash.
Piping a downloaded script straight into an interpreter runs unreviewed code. Download it to a file, review it, then run it.
Executing a downloaded script via process substitution runs unreviewed code. Download it to a file, review it, then run it.
Recursive chmod 777 makes everything world-writable. Grant only the permissions that are needed.
Reading secret files exposes credentials in the session transcript. Ask the user for the specific non-secret value you need.
